errors.text_span: всеки стълб се състои от две части
errors.evidence: The description states that each bar consists of two parts, which implies a stacked bar chart. The figure actually shows a grouped bar chart, where each category has two separate, side-by-side bars.

The prompt requires the inclusion of representative values, such as from the shortest and longest bars. The description omits any numerical data from the chart, such as the highest value (approx. 4.7) or the lowest value (approx. 1.7).
